lines.zh: 我几乎不动，只是被挪了一下位置。
lines.en: I barely move; I have only been shifted a little.

lines.zh: 我的脚没有着地，是被搬过来的。
lines.en: My feet never walked; I was carried here.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，保持这个角度。
lines.en: I keep my head at this angle.

lines.zh: 我在展示位上转了一点。
lines.en: I have turned a little on the display spot.

lines.zh: 我没有走路，是被人推过来的。
lines.en: I did not walk; I was pushed over.

lines.zh: 我的姿势一整天都没变。
lines.en: My pose has not changed all day.
The light washes me pale.

lines.zh: 我坐在这个位置，看着门口。
lines.en: I sit in this spot and watch the door.
Another layer of dust has settled on me.
My mouth stays open.

lines.zh: 这一整天，我只动了一次。
lines.en: I have moved exactly once all day.
I face where the crowd would be.

lines.zh: 我想抬脚，可关节卡住了。
lines.en: I try to lift a foot, but the joint is stuck.
My shadow shifts with the sun.

lines.zh: 我被摆在这里，就一直在。
lines.en: I was placed here, and here I remain.
I sit, like this, all day long.
Dust settles on my shoulder.
I hear someone pass outside.

lines.zh: 我的外壳裂了一道口子。
lines.en: A crack runs through my casing.

lines.zh: 白天我坐在展示位，一动不动。
lines.en: By day I sit on display without moving.

lines.zh: 这张桌子旁边，一直是这个位子。
lines.en: This has always been my place beside this table.
My head rests at this tilt, comfortably.

lines.zh: 灯灭了之后，这里更安静。
lines.en: After the lights go out, it is quieter here.

lines.zh: 我能听见自己的关节在响。
lines.en: I can hear my own joints clicking.
No one comes to look at me anymore.
Old paper scraps cling at my mouth.
I face the door, always.
My fingers have not moved all day.

lines.zh: 这里的味道是灰和旧布。
lines.en: It smells of dust and old cloth here.
I wait like this for nightfall.

lines.zh: 我看不见你，可我知道你来了。
lines.en: I cannot see you, yet I know you have come.

lines.zh: 你站在我前面，挡住了光。
lines.en: You stand before me and block the light.
My mouth has stayed open.
You have come a little closer.
My eyes give no answer.

lines.zh: 你看到我这副样子了吧。
lines.en: You see what I have come to, do you not?
I have not moved, not at all.
I can sense that someone is there.

lines.zh: 等我站起来，你就知道了。
lines.en: When I stand up, you will understand.
Under the lamp I am perfectly still.
Look at me as long as you like.
I rock once and settle back.
My casing splits further.
I do not cry out, and cannot move.
Dust shakes off me.
I take this one.
My head tips to the other side.
The chair scrapes on the floor.

lines.zh: 我还摆在原来那块板上。
lines.en: I am still on the same board.
When dark falls, someone will come.
I have no mouth for eating.
You hold it up, and I cannot move.
Put it on the table; I can see it.

lines.zh: 这东西对白天的我没用。
lines.en: It is no use to me by day.
What I want is for someone to come.
My jaw will not close.
You keep these.

lines.zh: 这点东西，摆在面前也没意义。
lines.en: Set before me, it still means nothing.
There is no stomach in this casing.
This body cannot use it.
That is kind of you, at least.
My fingers cannot reach.

lines.zh: 看起来很好吃，我尝不了。
lines.en: It looks good; I cannot taste it.
Leave it by my plate.
No one has touched anything on this table.

lines.zh: 你碰到了我，我晃了一下。
lines.en: You touch me and I rock slightly.

lines.zh: 我差点从位子上滑下去。
lines.en: I almost slip off the seat.
My head has tilted even further.
Dust falls from my shoulder.
I steady myself on the table edge.
That knocks my joints clicking.
I did not dodge, nor could I.
Careful; I am not steady.
My casing knocks a table corner.
I slowly settle back into place.
By day I do nothing at all.
I sit here and do not respond.
This body is only for display.
My eyes are still dark.

lines.zh: 这具壳里没有那种东西。
lines.en: There is no such thing inside this casing.
I tilt my head and do not move.

lines.zh: 等天黑了，会有别的玩偶。
lines.en: After dark, another animatronic will be here.
I cannot do anything more.
That is beyond me.
I simply sit here.
I cannot reach it, nor would I take it.
My fingers are stuck.
You put it away for me.

lines.zh: 它放在我的手上，掉不下来。
lines.en: It rests on my hand and will not fall.
I have no strength to grip.
This will gather dust.
I leave it on the table.
I cannot even lift it.
Let the one who comes at night have it.

lines.zh: 我注意到你了，可我没有动。
lines.en: I have noticed you, but I have not moved.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛暗着，什么也做不了。
lines.en: My eyes are dark; there is nothing I can do.
This face keeps pointing at you.
These two hands will not lift.
I heard, and that is all.
My head has shifted a little.
Stay a while longer.
Wait until the lights go out.
I am not chasing; I am only watching.

lines.zh: 你走到侧面，我的头没转。
lines.en: You move to the side and my head does not turn.

lines.zh: 我坐在这里，你走不掉的。
lines.en: I sit here; you will not get away.
The light shifts across me.

lines.zh: 我坐着，只能转向你的方向。
lines.en: Seated, I can only turn toward you.
I am only this pose.

lines.zh: 你回头看我的时候，我没有变。
lines.en: When you look back, I have not changed.
My mouth is still open.
It is nearly fully dark outside.

lines.zh: 我抬不起手，只能干看着。
lines.en: I cannot raise a hand; I can only watch.
My body will not move at all.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，什么也说不出。
lines.en: My mouth is open, and nothing comes out.
All day long, I only take hits.
My joints have locked.
I cannot even turn my head.
The lamp above is still burning.
Go on; I will stay here.

lines.zh: 我已经在这里摆了很久了。
lines.en: I have been set up here for a long while.
The lamp falls on me.
This room has opened its doors again.
I was carried here from the back room.
My spot faces the entrance.
Dust settles on my shoulder first.

lines.zh: 我坐好了，一整天都不会动。
lines.en: I am seated, and will not move all day.
People here have to pass this way.
My eyes have not lit.
My mouth is open.

lines.zh: 火烧到我的布，我坐着没法躲。
lines.en: Fire catches my cloth, and seated I cannot dodge.

lines.zh: 我从位子上滑下来，摔在地板上。
lines.en: I slide off the seat and crash to the floor.

lines.zh: 水漫上来，我连头都抬不起来。
lines.en: Water rises and I cannot even lift my head.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我从位子上掀翻。
lines.en: The blast throws me off the seat.

lines.zh: 有东西打在我脸上，留下一个坑。
lines.en: Something hits my face and leaves a pit.

lines.zh: 一股力压住我，我本来就动不了。
lines.en: Some force presses me down; I could not move anyway.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可我也会慢慢坏掉。
lines.en: I do not eat, yet I slowly decay too.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的机件跳了一下。
lines.en: Lightning hits and my parts jolt.

lines.zh: 地板没了，我带着位子一起掉下去。
lines.en: The floor is gone and I fall, seat and all.
